question: Did extra measured proposals improve the same engineering objective over uniform initialization, and did ridge assistance beat a simple measured baseline?
takeaway: All methods tie on Duck; on Avocado, measured greedy has the lowest mean, and ridge improves evolution alone without beating greedy.
variant: Faceted horizontal seed points with mean diamonds and observed min-to-max connectors
grain: One independently measured method, surrogate setting and seed run for one asset
measure: Minimum measured search loss + 0.2 * candidate bytes / source bytes within each run
scales: Independent, explicitly labeled zoomed x axes; no cross-asset ranking and no bar baseline
costTreatment: Uniform stops after five defined measurements; other methods use eight. Physical time is reported in a separate table, including initialization and fitting.
nonColorDistinction: Mean diamond; seeds use open circle, square and triangle; source assets use separate panels
qa: Inspect the exported PNG at native size and check values against the re-derived audit. The figure is embedded in benchmark-notes.md.
